radiatorCores.name: Radiator Cores
radiatorCores.description: High-performance radiator cores manufactured from premium copper and aluminum materials. Suitable for all vehicle types, ranging from passenger cars to heavy-duty industrial machinery. Custom manufacturing options are available based on specific dimensions and technical requirements.

fullRadiators.name: Full Radiators
fullRadiators.description: Ready-to-install, complete radiator units manufactured to OEM standards. Provides maximum engine protection even in harsh conditions thanks to superior cooling capacity and durable construction. Meets all market demands with a comprehensive product range.

intercoolers.name: Intercoolers
intercoolers.description: High-efficiency air-to-air and air-to-water intercooler systems designed for turbocharged and supercharged engines. Maximizes engine performance and fuel efficiency by increasing the density of intake air. Perfectly suited for all commercial and industrial vehicles.

oilCoolers.name: Oil Coolers
oilCoolers.description: Advanced oil cooling solutions ensuring optimal operating temperatures for engine and transmission systems. Prevents overheating, significantly reducing mechanical wear and extending component lifespan. Built with durable materials to withstand high pressure and tough working environments.

acRadiators.name: AC Radiators
acRadiators.description: Specially developed condenser and evaporator units for vehicle climate control systems. Offers rapid heat transfer to provide ideal cabin comfort throughout all seasons. Leak-tested, highly reliable, and designed for a long service life.

industrialCoolers.name: Industrial Coolers
industrialCoolers.description: Heavy-duty cooling systems engineered for industrial machinery, generators, and large-scale facilities. Delivers superior thermal management in demanding environments requiring continuous operation. Fully customizable designs supported by project-specific engineering.

heaters.name: Heaters
heaters.description: Compact and highly efficient heater cores designed for vehicle cabin heating systems. Guarantees rapid and effective heating performance even in extreme cold weather conditions. Features easy installation and is crafted from materials with excellent thermal conductivity.

aftercoolers.name: Aftercoolers
aftercoolers.description: High-tech aftercooler units designed for air compressors and industrial compressed air systems. Removes excess heat generated after compression to maintain system efficiency and prevent condensation. Compact design and rugged construction help reduce maintenance costs.

about.pageDescription: Manufacturing in Istanbul since 1983. 43 years experience, ISO 9001:2015 certified, 7,000 m² facility. Turkey's leading radiator producer.
about.heading: About Us

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: KADA Auto Radiator was founded in 1983 in Güneşli, Istanbul, as a small workshop driven by a passion for quality and craftsmanship in the radiator industry. That founding commitment has grown into one of Turkey's leading radiator manufacturers.
story.p2: With over 43 years of experience, we manufacture copper, aluminum, and brass-based cooling products across a 7,000 m² production facility equipped with state-of-the-art CNC machinery. Our ISO 9001:2015 certification reflects our unwavering commitment to international quality standards.
story.p3: Today, KADA exports to 35 countries and serves over 500 authorized dealers. Our product range covers passenger vehicles, commercial trucks, agricultural machinery, forklifts, and industrial generators — delivering reliable cooling solutions for every application.

steps.title: Engineering and 3D Modeling (OEM Matching)
steps.description: Based on original OEM codes and master demands, parts and casting tanks designs are digitized with 100% precision in SolidWorks environment.

steps.title: Certified Raw Material Analysis
steps.description: First-class copper, brass, and aluminum sheets with high thermal conductivity are taken from international certified suppliers to melting and testing stages.

steps.title: CNC Embossing and Molding (Core Manufacturing)
steps.description: In our state-of-the-art CNC machines, vertical circulation tubes and core fins, which form the heart of the radiator, are bent millimetrically with special molds.

steps.title: Robotic Integrated Assembly and Welding
steps.description: Shroud sheets, side plates, and water tanks are assembled in robotic welding lines resistant to shock and high pressure before powder coating.

steps.title: Hardcore Pressure and Leakage Tests
steps.description: Every radiator produced is subjected to water tightness and thermal simulation tests under high bar pressure for durability against tough construction site and military terrain conditions.

steps.title: Protective Packaging and Global Logistics
steps.description: Input-output fittings are closed with green protective plugs, and part series placed in special thick packaging boxes are safely shipped throughout Turkey and to 35 countries.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To create value for our customers by producing cooling solutions at the highest quality standards and to be a trusted brand in the global market.

isoSection.label: QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
isoSection.heading: ISO 9001:2015
isoSection.p1: As Turkey's leading ISO 9001:2015 certified radiator manufacturer, our certificate approved by DQS is an independent assurance that our production processes meet international quality standards.
isoSection.p2: This document certifies that in our quality-assured radiator manufacturing, every stage from raw material procurement to production, quality control, and delivery is systematically managed.
isoSection.p3: Thanks to our DQS-approved production approach, our customers receive guaranteed consistent quality, reliable delivery, and a traceable process with every order.

pressure.title: Pressure Testing
pressure.description: Every radiator unit undergoes high-pressure testing after production. Conducted above standard operating pressures, this test detects any potential structural weaknesses before delivery. No product is shipped without passing this test.

leak.title: Leak Testing
leak.description: Our advanced leak detection systems identify even micro-level leaks. Every joint and weld line is individually inspected. Guaranteed leak-tightness is a standard for all our products.

thermal.title: Thermal Endurance Testing
thermal.description: Our products are subjected to extreme temperature cycles to test thermal expansion and durability. These tests simulate actual field conditions to guarantee long-lasting performance.

items.question: What is the scope of KADA's ISO certification?
items.answer: KADA Auto Radiator holds the ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System certificate approved by DQS. This certificate covers all our production processes.

items.question: What tests do your products undergo?
items.answer: Every product is shipped after passing pressure testing, leak testing, and thermal endurance testing.

items.question: How can I verify your quality certificates?
items.answer: Our ISO 9001:2015 certificate is issued by DQS, and a copy of the document can be provided upon request.
